entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello? I need some help with a recent order. I have a VeloBand Cadence Sensor and it's not working at all.

Hello, you've reached VeloFit customer support. My name is Charlie. I can certainly help you with that. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with the band?
It's definitely a technical fault. It just won't sync with the app. I've followed all the instructions, tried reinstalling, everything. I think the unit itself is broken.

I'm sorry to hear you're having that trouble. It's frustrating when a new device doesn't perform as expected. It sounds like you believe the item is defective. Do you have your order number handy so I can pull up your details?
Yes, it's VF886-01. I received it about 18 days ago. I'm hoping we can work something out, since it's clearly a defective product.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 18th. Let me just check our policy for you.
Alright, I've reviewed it, and I have good news. You are well within our 90-day return window. I can process a full refund for you right away.
Oh! That's fantastic. I was prepared to negotiate a bit, but a full refund is perfect. That's much easier than I expected.

I'm glad we could resolve this for you. I've just initiated that return. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just place the band back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item.
That sounds great. I've already got the email. Thank you for your help, Charlie.
You are very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
